next_question_bundle.answer: They did not support these ideas; they argued against such constitutional tinkering, stating that the position being unelected is an asset and that an election would politicize the office, thereby undermining the impartiality necessary for the governor general to function properly.
next_question_bundle.required_new_fact_from_doc_b: The specific arguments made by constitutional scholars, editorial boards, and the Monarchist League of Canada regarding the politicization of the office.
